info.name: FollowUpAgent – API Contract v1.0
info.description:
How CRM and the local AI service talk to each other.

1. CRM pushes candidate info + audio link to AI.
2. AI runs Speech-to-Text + LLM in the background.
3. AI posts the result back to CRM via webhook.

AI runs on localhost – no internet needed.

request.description: CRM sends candidate info here. Pass the audio as a URL – not a file upload.

response.name: 202 – queued, processing in background

item.name: 2. AI sends result back to CRM via webhook

request.description: AI posts the result here when it's done. CRM side needs to have this endpoint up and ready, otherwise the result gets dropped.
